THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No : 3/2/3/10/275. Land Ministry Ref. No : 4-3/7/2021/HW/360. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired : Lot No. 2 - 45 (19 Lots) allotments in total extent of about 0.3331 Hectare, of land in Cadastral Map No. 510614, Block No. 02 and Sheet No. 7, dated 14.10.2024 prepared by the Senior - Superintendent of Surveys of Gampaha District on behalf of the Surveyor General, situated in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 328, Paththalagedara in village of Paththalagedara in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Attanagalla in Gampaha District in the Western Province.
